sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE GAJENDRA SINGH  ON THE 6 th OF AUGUST, 2025  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1484 of 2016  GOLU @ VIJAY
Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH
Shri Rajesh Joshi G.A appearing on behalf of State.

ORDER This Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 05.07.2016 in S.T.No.385/2013 by the First ASJ, Khargone whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Sections 363 (A) and 366 and 376 (2) (i) of the Indian Penal Code and under section 3/4 of The Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012 sentenced to undergo 05 years R.I with fine Rs.1000/- and 07 years R.I with fine Rs2000/- and 10 years R.I with fine of Rs.7,000/-
respectively with default stipulation.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. This appeal arises out of the incident dated 23.10.2013 in which accused Kidnapped a minor girl and committed Rape with the minor girl (prosecutrix) regarding which a Crime No.075/2013 was registered at Police Station Onn, Khargone.

3. The PUD No.1002/Warrant/2025 dated 19.06.2025 of Jail NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21531 2 CRA-1484-2016 Superintendent, Khargone mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 03.10.2023.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
